mapper.sql: k.id, k.subject_id, k.name, k.aliases, k.question_count, k.status, k.created_at, k.updated_at
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM rk_knowledge_point k
k.subject_id = #{subjectId}
AND k.status = 'ENABLED'
ORDER BY k.question_count DESC, k.id ASC
LIMIT 1000
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rk_knowledge_point (subject_id, name, aliases, status) VALUES (#{subjectId}, #{name}, #{aliases}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rk_question_kp WHERE kp_id = #{kpId}
mapper.update: UPDATE rk_knowledge_point k SET k.question_count = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rk_question_kp qk JOIN rk_question q ON q.id = qk.question_id WHERE qk.kp_id = k.id AND q.status = 'PUBLISHED' ) WHERE k.id = #{kpId}
